lines.text: The LORD says Israel sells the needy for a pair of shoes and tramples on the heads of the poor.
They lie down beside every altar on garments taken in pledge and drink wine obtained through fines.
The LORD destroyed the Amorite, then brought Israel up from Babylon and led them forty years in the wilderness.
The LORD raised up prophets and Nazirites, but Israel made the Nazirites drink wine and told the prophets not to prophesy.
The LORD will crush Israel, and the swift, the strong, the archer and the horseman will not save their lives.
